paite: Huan Saul in atapa Jonathan leh asikha tengteng kiang ah David thah ding thu agen hi.
heading: Saul In David Asawi

paite: Himahleh Saul tapa Jonathan in David adeihthoh mahmah hi. Jonathan in, "Ka pa Saul in thah ding in hon zong hi, huaiziak in, zingchiang zingsang in pilvang inla mun-guk ah bu nilouh in.
Ka pawtkhe dia, na omna gamlak ah ka pa kiang ah ka va dingh dia, na tungtang thu ah ka pa ka houpih ding. Huchi in ka muhdan ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
Jonathan in apa Saul ma ah David aphat a, akiang ah, "Asikha David tung ah kumpipa khial het kei hen. Na tung ah lah akhial kei a, athilhihte lah nang a dia hoih pipi ahi zaw ngal ua.

Sih khawk sa lou in Philistia mi asual a, TOUPA'N Israel tengteng a ding in hotdamna thupitak asepkhiaksak hi. Huai nang ngei in na mu a, na kipak mahmah hi. Huaiziak in sisan poi khoih lou tung ah bang ding in ahia na khelh ding, aziak bangmah om lou a David na thah ding?" achi hi.
Huchi in Saul in Jonathan thugen azui hi. Saul in kichiam in, "TOUPA ahin lai teng amah thah ahi kei ding," achi hi.
Jonathan in David asam a, huai thil tengteng ahilh hi. Jonathan in Saul kiang ah David api a, tuma lam mah bang in akiang ah a-om nawnta hi.
Kidouna ahong om nawn a, David akuankhia hi. Philistia mite ava sual a, tamtak ava that a, ama ah ataikek uhi.
Saul bel a-inn a teipi tawi a, atut lai in atung ah TOUPA sawl kha gilou ahong tung hi. David in kaihging atum hi.
Saul in ateipi in David baang toh khohden atum hi. Himahleh Saul kiang a pan akitholhkhe geih a, teipi pen baang ah akhohtal hi. Huchi in David ataikhia a, huai zan in asuakta hi.
Saul in azingsang a David tang a that ding in mi asawl hi. David zi Mikal in, tuzan a na hinna na humbit keileh zingchiang in hon that ding uh, chi in ahilh hi.
Mikal in David tohlet ah akhaikhesuk a; huchi in ataimang a, asuakta hi.
Mikal in milim ala a, lupna ah alumsak a, alulam ah kel mul lukham akoih a, puan in akhuh hi.
David pi dia Saul in mi ahon sawl kiang ah, "Achi ana," ana chi hi.
Saul in David va en ding in mi asawl nawn a, "Alupna toh hon zawngtou le uchin ka na that ding," achi hi.
Amisawlte ava lut uleh, ngai in, lupna ah milim alulam a kel mul lukham kham in ana om hi.

Saul in Mikal kiang ah, "Bangziak a hichibang a hon khem a, bitna dia ka melma pawtsak na hia?" achi hi. Mikal in Saul adawng a, "Hon paisak in, bangziak a nang hon that ding ka hia? ahon chi,” achi hi.
Huchi in David ataimang a, asuakta hi. Ramah a Samuel kiang ava tung a, Saul in atung a athilhih tengteng ava hilh hi. Amah leh Samuel akuan ua, Naioth ah a-om uhi.
Ngai in, Ramah a Naioth ah David a-om, chi in Saul ahilh uh.

Huchi in David pi ding in Saul in thupotu asawl hi. Zawlnei pawlte thugenkhol a a-om lai uh leh Samuel atung ua heutu a om ava muh un Saul in amisawl thupote tung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung a, amau leng thugenkhol in a-om sam uhi.
Huai Saul ahilh uleh, thupotu dang asawl nawn a, amau leng thugenkhol in ava om zel uhi. Saul in athumveina ding in thupotu dang asawl nawn a, amau leng thugenkhol in ava om nawn zel uhi.
Amah leng Ramah ah ava hoh a, Seku mun a tuileh lian mahmah ava pha hi. "Samuel leh David koi a om ahi ua?" chi in adong hi. Mi kuahiam khat in, "Ngai in, Ramah a Naioth ah a-om uh," achi hi.
Ramah a Naioth ah ahoh a; Pathian kha atung ah ahong tung samta a, apai zel hi. Ramah a Naioth atun matan thugenkhol in a-om lai hi.
Ama'n apuansilhte leng asuah a, Samuel ma ah thugenkhol in a-om a, huai ni nitum leh huai zankhua in vuaktang in alum hi. Huaiziak in "Saul leng zawlnei lak a tel sam ahi maw?" achi uhi.
